torchlit.config.title: Torchlit
torchlit.config.enabled.tooltip: Master switch for all of Torchlit's features. Disabled is vanilla lighting.
torchlit.config.world_darkness.tooltip: Controls how dark an area can get without any light. At high values, dark areas are pitch black. Low values look closer to vanilla's lighting, with 0% leaving unlit areas as vanilla.
torchlit.config.moon_influence.tooltip: Controls how much the moon phase affects brightness at night. At high values a new moon is pitch black, while a full moon is still light enough to see. Lower this value if you never want the surface to be pitch black.
torchlit.config.weather_influence.toolti: Controls how much weather such as rain and thunderstorms can darken surface lighting. At 0, weather has no effect, and at full thunderstorms can result in pitch black nights on certain moon phases.
torchlit.config.fog_darkness.tooltip: Controls how much the fog loses its glow. At higher values, fog is dimmed greatly, nearly turning black. Only affects the Nether and End.
torchlit.config.eye_adaptation.tooltip: Controls how strongly your eyes adjust to bright light. At high values, looking at a light makes dark surroundings fade to black, and stepping into bright light briefly causes glare.
torchlit.config.dimension.tooltip: Controls how strongly the world darkens in this dimension. At 0%, Torchlit is off in this dimension.
torchlit.config.container_darkness.toolt: Controls how dark menus get in low light, based on the light level at the block's (or your) position. 0% is vanilla, 100% is pitch black.
torchlit.config.hotbar_darkness.tooltip: Controls how dark the hotbar gets in low light, based on the light level you stand in.
torchlit.config.light_detail.tooltip: Controls how finely light from items is drawn in menus and the hotbar, in GUI pixels. Lower values give smoother light around light sources.
torchlit.config.books_and_signs.tooltip: Darkens books, lecterns and the sign editor. Does not darken buttons.
torchlit.config.status_bars.tooltip: Darken health, hunger, armor and experience, and any modded status bars.
torchlit.config.items_emit_light.tooltip: Light-emitting blocks such as torches light up nearby slots and the cursor while carried.
torchlit.config.affect_creative.tooltip: Whether or not creative players are affected by container and HUD darkening.
